title: Frog Queen in Plasma Sphere
description: A surreal scene inside a transparent glowing sphere features a central red female face with wild neon green hair, wide open screaming mouth, and glowing blue eyes emitting purple lightning bolts. The sphere contains multiple green frogs and golden robotic figures surrounding her against a dark background.
prompt: A surreal composition centered inside a large transparent plasma sphere against a dark background. A bright red female face with an angry screaming expression and glowing blue eyes sits at the core, her wild neon green hair flowing outward. She emits powerful purple lightning bolts. Surrounding her are several realistic green frogs and shiny golden steampunk robots. The entire scene crackles with electric energy and vibrant colors.
